description: Four-band parametric EQ for all 24 tracks, groups and aux busses of a MixMaster, patched in through the mixer's polyphonic inserts, with one set of band controls showing the track that is selected

params.text: Selects which of the 24 tracks the band controls, the gain, the spectrum display and the meter belong to
Switches the EQ of the selected track between active and bypassed
Sets the output gain of the selected track, -20dB to +20dB
Switches that band in or out of the selected track's EQ
Sets the frequency of the low band, 20Hz to 500Hz
Sets the frequency of the low-mid band, 30Hz to 2kHz
Sets the frequency of the high-mid band, 500Hz to 5kHz
Sets the frequency of the high band, 1kHz to 20kHz
Sets the boost or cut of that band, -20dB to +20dB
Sets the Q of that band, 0.3 to 20, narrowing it as the value rises
Switches the low band between a low shelf and a bell
Switches the high band between a high shelf and a bell
Bypasses the EQ on all 24 tracks at once

inputs.text: Takes the mixer's poly insert send for tracks 1 to 8, sixteen channels carrying a left and a right for each
Takes the mixer's poly insert send for tracks 9 to 16, sixteen channels carrying a left and a right for each
Takes the mixer's poly insert send for the four group busses and four aux busses, sixteen channels carrying a left and a right for each

outputs.text: Carries tracks 1 to 8 back to the mixer's poly insert return
Carries tracks 9 to 16 back to the mixer's poly insert return
Carries the four group busses and four aux busses back to the mixer's poly insert return

notes: the EQ does nothing until a poly insert cable from a MixMaster is patched into one of the three inputs and the matching output is patched back to the mixer.
right-clicking the track label opens a menu of its own, with Initialize track settings, Copy track settings to:, Move track settings to: and a Select Track list of all 24.
right-clicking a band's frequency readout opens a menu of its own, with that band's CV attenuator and a Show freq as note item that reads the frequencies out as note names.
right-clicking a knob types an exact value into it.
menu: Link to mixer — takes the 24 track names and colours from a named MixMaster in the patch
Track/band active CVs — reads the EqSpander jacks as Trigger toggle, or as Gate high/low
Analyser decay — sets how fast the spectrum display falls back
Hide EQ curves when bypassed — stops a bypassed track's curve being drawn in the display
Knob arcs — draws the knob position arc, the CV arc, both or neither
Display colour — sets the colour of the readouts
VU colour — sets the colour of the meter
